source.title: Régimes français depuis 1789 — Assemblée nationale
source.citation_text: The French National Assembly historical regime table dates the Second Bourbon Restoration from 8 July 1815 to 2 August 1830 and the July Monarchy from 2 August 1830 to 24 February 1848. This is the broad regime/state-form chronology used by P2-01J, distinct from Louis-Philippe's later 9 August constitutional oath.

designation.notes: Reviewed broad July Monarchy state-form interval on stable France. The French National Assembly regime table uses 2 August 1830, Charles X's abdication, as the regime boundary and 24 February 1848 as its end. This state-form axis intentionally differs from the existing constitutional_regime governance period beginning 9 August 1830, when Louis-Philippe accepted and swore the revised Charter as King of the French. The shared 2 August transition date with the Second Restoration is retained as the official boundary rather than falsified into an invented one-day gap. Coarse year-only Person Activities are never given fabricated day precision.
